messages:
maria: quick heads-up, CobaltCorp wants a 2-week Dedicated POC. Requirements: SSO (SAML idp/sp flows), SCIM delta provisioning, SCIM groups->RBAC, domain lock to cobaltcorp.com, audit streaming to Splunk, EU data residency. Any immediate blockers?

dev-oliver: all supported. SAML: both flows, persistent NameID preferred. We'll provide SP metadata and ACS URL. No technical blockers.

ps-kate: POC steps: 1) spin trial tenant + 2-card Dedicated pool 2) exchange SAML metadata 3) initial SCIM bulk import then enable delta 4) map 3 groups to roles 5) enable audit forward. Expect 5-7 business days with IdP admin access.

ben-sales: commercial note: pilot priced at 50% off for 2 weeks, invoice upfront. If they convert to annual commit we credit pilot fee. Need concurrency and avg token size to finalize quote.

maria: they estimate 120 concurrent sessions, chat ~256 tokens.

dev-oliver: that should be fine; I'll include a small sizing note. SCIM rate limits: hosted default 600/min, Dedicated pilot can bump during onboarding. We support PATCH and delta via lastModified filter.

sec-tina: security checklist: SOC2 Type II yes, pen test summary we can share under NDA, KMS customer-managed available for Private, audit streaming via HTTPS/syslog with token auth, default log retention 12 months (can extend). I'll attach docs.

audit-bot: uploaded security-pack.pdf and scim-template.csv to the thread (link: https://redwood.internal/qna/2795554321).

maria: next steps: dev-oliver to post sizing + SAML template by EOD, ps-kate to draft runbook and SCIM mapping, ben to send pilot term email. Schedule kickoff with Cobalt IdP admin for Wednesday. Thanks!
